9mm NATO is not the same spec as the others. The dimensions are slightly different, not typically enough to matter, the rounds are a bit heavier (124gr vs 115), and it's quite a bit hotter, falling in between +P and +P+ compared to the Luger spec. I don't recommend firing NATO spec ammo in cheap 9mm handguns, and you might consider a stronger return spring to help preserve the frame if you're going to standardize on it.

NATO has different specifications and methods for measuring pressures than SAAMI or C.I.P., but aside from using the submachinegun ammunition, no pistol round of any standard should blow up a modern pistol. NATO standards are essentially the same as SAAMI or C.I.P. standards for 9mm by other synonymous names.
